rss: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
title: Gadget Sales Go Downhill
story: Lots of kids love gadgets, but recently fewer people are buying them. This means gadget companies like APPS, WTCH, and VRVR aren’t selling as much and their prices have gone down.
storyBig: A recent downturn in tech stocks has led to a significant decline in market value for companies like APPS, WTCH, and VRVR. Investors are concerned about the future profitability of these companies as consumer demand shifts.
think: Why do you think people are buying fewer gadgets?
bull: Gadget companies might create even cooler tech to attract buyers.
bear: If sales continue dropping, some companies might reduce their gadget production.

title: Game Sales Break Records
story: A popular video game just sold a lot of copies on its first day! This shows how much kids and grown-ups love video games, making PIXL a very successful company.
storyBig: PIXL has set a new benchmark in the gaming industry with the release of its latest game, which achieved record-breaking sales. This highlights the massive demand and excitement for high-quality gaming experiences.
think: What makes a video game super fun and popular?
bull: PIXL’s success shows that video games can be a big hit and make a lot of money.
bear: If PIXL doesn’t keep up with new trends, people might get bored of their games.
